reference: Decode both stored rows with the pinned GGML scalar loads and row decoders. For Q8_K use its original decoder and for Q8_1 use the original Q4_1 × Q8_1 dot product with independently decoded one-hot basis rows. Store the decoded words with the pinned destination encoders or scalar stores. Use uniform importance weights for codebooks that require them. Berkeley SoftFloat converts I64 and F64 and checks the representable signed output domain.
